headline: Easy breeding chain: Helzephyr
title: Easy Helzephyr Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Here is how to breed Helzephyr, a fast dark flying mount, starting from Pals you can catch easily. Step one: breed Bushi with Vanwyrm to get Felbat. Step two: breed that Felbat with Wumpo to get Suzaku. Step three: breed Suzaku with Reptyro, and the egg hatches into Helzephyr! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Helzephyr: Bushi + Vanwyrm = Felbat, Felbat + Wumpo = Suzaku, Suzaku + Reptyro = Helzephyr. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
